verifications.claim: Flynn Clayman is the head men's basketball coach at High Point University.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Panthers coach Flynn Clayman', 'Clayman is in his first season as High Point’s [head coach]'; R3: 'hiring of Flynn Clayman as the new men's basketball head coach'; R4: 'head coach of the High Point Panthers'; R5: 'High Point head coach Flynn Clayman'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm Clayman as head men's basketball coach at High Point.

verifications.claim: Flynn Clayman was hired in April 2025 following a stint as associate head coach.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'hiring ... on Friday, April 11th'; R4: 'Promoted to head coach in April 2025 ... after serving as his associate head coach'; R5: 'promoted to head coach ... last April'; R1: 'promoted ... had been Huss’ top assistant for the previous two seasons'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm promotion/hiring in April 2025 from associate head coach role.

verifications.claim: Flynn Clayman led the Panthers to a 31-4 record in his first full season.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: '30-4 this season after the win over Wisconsin'; R4: '2025–26 High Point 31–4'; R5: '31-4 campaign in his first full season'
verifications.reasoning: R4 and R5 support 31-4 exactly, but R1 states 30-4 after the same first-round win, creating a numerical contradiction.

verifications.claim: High Point University's men's basketball program had its first NCAA tournament appearance in Flynn Clayman's first full season.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'previous two seasons ... made one NCAA tournament appearance'; R3: 'helped lead the Panthers to their first ever-NCAA tournament appearance'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm the first NCAA appearance was in a prior season (2025) when Clayman was associate head coach, not his first full head coaching season (2025-26).

verifications.claim: The Panthers won back-to-back Big South regular-season titles.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'back-to-back outright Big South Regular Season titles'; R5: 'first team from the Big South to win back-to-back conference regular-season titles since Coastal Carolina in 2011'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state the Panthers achieved back-to-back Big South regular-season titles.
